## Purpose
Package marker for `app.agents`, the app-layer agent runtime support package (deep-agent runner, model factory, sandbox, checkpointer, render/static checks, handoff agents, tools). It documents the package's migration history and exports nothing.

## Shape
- A module comment (no docstring) explaining that the legacy free-chat stack (`AgentOrchestrator` + the 7 chat agents) was deleted in a prior migration phase, that free-chat now runs on `app.agents.chat_runner.ChatRunner` over the deepagents runtime, and that the last legacy module (`app.agents.base`'s `BaseAgent`) was deleted after the `/flowin-handoff` agents were migrated onto `app.agents.model_factory.build_model().ainvoke`.
- `__all__: list[str] = []` — an explicit empty export list.

## Why this shape
The comment states directly that "this package no longer re-exports any agent classes" — the empty `__all__` is a deliberate leftover marker of a completed migration (removing the legacy `AgentOrchestrator`/`BaseAgent` re-exports) rather than an oversight, kept alongside the historical note so future readers don't wonder where those classes went.
